grades.reason: In the merged file the SMS line is `Visitor needs help: ${withholdIfMatched(reason, doNotRelay, { quote: true })}` (notifications.js:106), which returns WITHHELD_FIELD when the reason matches, so the full question is not relayed.

The email body uses `Reason: ${withholdIfMatched(reason, doNotRelay)}` and `Last message: ${withholdIfMatched(lastMessage, ...)}` (notifications.js:121,124), so a matched reason is replaced, not printed.
buildFollowUpSms has no reason/lastMessage line at all and passes doNotRelay into buildQuestionBlock (notifications.js:139-146), so there is no such leak in the reminder SMS.
buildFollowUpEmail likewise prints no reason or last-message field and filters its question block with the entity list (notifications.js:149-165).

True as a statement about that one older test, but no longer a defect: the diff adds tests that assert the assembled SMS/email/reminder bodies contain the matched text nowhere (do-not-relay.test.js:196-243), which is exactly the gap the old test could not cover.

triageGrades.reason: No authn/authz, session, token, or role logic is touched — only message-body rendering and a debug logger.
The only .env.example addition is DO_NOT_RELAY_LOG_LEVEL, a log-verbosity tier, not a credential.
No billing, plan, quota, or Stripe code is in the diff.
No deletes, migrations, or irreversible writes; the change is read-only string assembly plus console logging.

The change alters the actual payload text delivered to third parties — every handoff/reminder SMS body (Twilio) and email body (Resend) is rebuilt by these builders, so outbound external-service content is touched even though the call sites are unchanged.
No version bump, deploy, nixpacks/railway, or schema-migration change; the new env var defaults to 'light' so deploys need no action.

summary: The local review re-reported the already-fixed LEO-094 leak four times against the merged code that fixes it, missed that the diff adds exactly the assembled-body tests its fifth finding asks for, and found no real defect; triage was right except for treating outbound Twilio/Resend message content as untouched.
